schema: §2.7 (v0.50) -- complete per-sentence segment disposition. `not_annotatable` (§21 R6's original array, the only key run_scoring.load_not_annotatable() reads) is preserved for scoring and holds every NOT_OBLIGATION_BEARING / NOT_ANNOTATABLE / EXCLUDED span. `dispositions` is the full per-sentence record §2.7 requires.

reconciliation.note: Dispositioned at SUB-SENTENCE granularity: 5 sentences but 8 structurally distinct spans. The count of 2 is the eligibility finding and it rests on two reviewer rulings -- S2's duty is NOT_ANNOTATABLE under §4.3.1 STEP 2 (S3 restates it completely), and S3's proviso is EXCLUDED as a savings/reservation provision. Had the proviso been kept the count would be 3, still within §2's 1-3 band; had S2's duty ALSO been annotated it would be 4 and over band. Neither ruling was made to reach a count: each is recorded on its own ground in the item notes and the exclusion log respectively.

dispositions.reason: Section heading fragment -- no modal, no finite verb, no subject+predicate.

THE FIRST MATERIAL INSTANCE OF §4.3.1 STEP 2, APPLIED AS DESIGNED. S2 states the duty GENERALLY ('a quality agreement'); S3, TAKEN AS A UNIT, restates it COMPLETELY -- limbs (a) and (b) together specify both quality agreements and both deadlines, which is exactly what S2 leaves general. Step 2's test is COMPLETENESS, and completeness does not require the more-complete statement to be a single clause. Marked NOT_ANNOTATABLE per step 2 so a prediction aligning here counts as NEITHER a correct item NOR a false positive (§4.4). Step 2 had carried 'STATUS: UNTESTED' since v0.28; this is validation of its design, not a strain on it. Recorded verbatim with offsets as step 2 prescribes. NOT a discarded draft: this span was drafted in full as a candidate item and NOT_ANNOTATABLE is its correct disposition once the segment's whole structure is understood.

dispositions.reason: 'which Quality Agreement shall be incorporated herein by reference.' -- non-party subject (the Quality Agreement, a document) and a legal-effect/incorporation statement, not commanded conduct. §8.8's own named class; same ground as E03-037's excluded deeming clause and C17-038's survival clause.

dispositions.reason: Covers locked item E03-05 (S3 limb (b)). Span runs from the shared subject per §8.3.1 v0.31 option 4, so it properly CONTAINS E03-04's span; nested IoU 192/436 = 0.440, BELOW §4.1's 0.5 threshold, so the two cannot mis-align to each other.
dispositions.span_text: For clarity, the Parties shall agree to the terms and conditions of (a) the Quality 5 ​ Agreement for the Product for Development use as soon as reasonably practicable after the Effective Date, and (b) the Quality Agreement for the Product for Commercial uses, if different than the Quality Agreement specified in subsection (a), as soon as reasonably practicable after the first MAA for the Product is submitted in the Kissei Territory

dispositions.reason: 'provided that the Quality Agreement may be amended if mutually agreed by the Parties.' -- states a power that exists by default; any contract may be amended by mutual agreement. Creates no new contractual entitlement. Full ground in exclusions.json entry E03-022#amendment-proviso. THIS EXCLUSION IS LOAD-BEARING FOR THE CLAUSE COUNT.
dispositions.span_text: provided that the Quality Agreement may be amended if mutually agreed by the Parties.

dispositions.reason: Conflict-precedence provision. Subject is 'the terms of this Supply Agreement' (a thing); 'shall control' states which provisions govern, an interpretive/legal-effect statement rather than any party's duty. C03-102 / C12-017 / C02-062's class.
dispositions.span_text: To the extent that the terms of this Supply Agreement and those of the Quality Agreement are in conflict, the terms of this Supply Agreement shall control except with respect to quality issues, which shall be governed by the Quality Agreement.

dispositions.reason: Second conflict-precedence provision, flagged 'For clarity'. Subject is 'this Supply Agreement' -- §8.8's named Agreement-as-subject class. §4.3.1 is NOT invoked between this and S4: neither is an item, so there is no restatement to resolve.
dispositions.span_text: For clarity, if there are any financial terms in the Quality Agreement that are in conflict with this Supply Agreement, this Supply Agreement shall control with respect to such financial terms.
